title: Article provenance passport
description: Article-level provenance record tracing an article from its Arabic governing source through reference layers, extraction, remediation, QA, and human review, with a risk lane. Arabic governs. Not legal advice.

reference_layers.description: Reference/internal layers (e.g. english_reference, chinese_internal) with their per-article status/hash.

source_basis.description: Article-level source basis under the repository review model, e.g. official_source_based.

repository_legal_review_status.description: Repository-owner review status for this article, e.g. repository_owner_review_active.

external_legal_review_status.description: External legal review status (optional for enterprise/official adoption; not required for repository use), e.g. not_performed.

official_status.description: Official-status boundaries for this article (no official translation/adoption; Chinese not official/binding/governing; not legal advice).

human_legal_review_status.description: Deprecated: superseded by repository_legal_review_status + external_legal_review_status. Optional for backward compatibility only; not a required or central field.
